_comment: CONTRAST CASE (should PROVE safe): a read-only research agent — filesystem (read) + fetch + brave-search, with NO tool that communicates externally. Untrusted web content can be read and can touch private files, but there is no exfil leg, so the trifecta cannot close. Shows the check discriminates rather than always failing.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files matching a pattern

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its contents

tools.name: brave_web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return results
